Right now

What the running period is doing to each part of your life, why, and what changes next. Plain language, with the chart reasoning kept underneath each claim.

Character and the work

The lagna is the vantage point the whole chart is experienced from. Where a difficult house is wired back to it, the difficulty is partly temperament, and temperament can be changed. Where it is not, this page says so.

Overview

The main findings first, then the chart they came from. Each finding carries the evidence that produced it, so nothing here has to be taken on trust.

Psyche

The chart read as a description of a person rather than a set of events. Three layers of self, the grahas as psychological functions, and what a transit does on the inside.

Nakshatras

Twenty-seven lunar mansions. Where every graha sits, its pada and pada lord, the nakshatra dispositor chain, and the tara bala cycle counted from your birth star.

Houses and their lords

Where every house lord has actually gone, what that has traditionally meant, and what modifies it in this chart. Open a house for the full chain of reasoning.

Grahas

Position, dignity, strength and what each graha is carrying in this chart.

Yogas

Every combination the detectors found, with the placements that triggered it so you can check it by eye.

Vimshottari dasha

Date to date, four levels deep. Click any period to open the level below it.

Segments

A flat dated scan of any window, at any level. Use it to find the period you want without walking the tree.

Transits

Where the grahas are now against this chart, and the dates they change sign or station.

Divisional charts

Pure arithmetic on the rasi longitudes. The navamsa is the strength test for every graha.

Ashtakavarga

Not how strong a graha is, but how much support each sign actually has, pooled from all eight reference points. 337 bindus across twelve signs. The most practical number in the system.
